name: Myopia Hunt Club
architects: Herbert C. Leeds (1894-1901; R. M. Appleton laid out the first nine, 1894); Gil Hanse tree and fairway work since 2011

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM (3DEPElevation exportImage, project MA_CentralEastern_2021_B21, 2021 USGS Lidar: Central Eastern Massachusetts, leaf-off spring 2021), x 346700-348600 / y 4718100-4720200 EPSG:32619, NAVD88 metres, clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py raster; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-myopia)

laz.source: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud, project MA_CentralEastern_2021_B21 (leaf-off spring 2021), 4 tiles, classes 3-5 clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py laz (CRS kept); fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-myopia; three tiles on retry runs)
laz.label: 2021 USGS lidar, leaf-off

scorecard_source: Third-party (no official card online): Stymie and GolfPass give the same current card hole by hole (Red, White, Yellow from Stymie; Green from GolfPass), read 2026-10-24 by the scouting chat (docs/scouting/myopia/scorecard_sources.md, branch scouting/new-courses); every row adds up. Ratings from Stymie (Red 72.7/138, also golfcoursegurus and Wikipedia). Unverified against a printed card.
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2021 Central Eastern Massachusetts lidar)
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-11-13: the longest tee set (Red) and it is the default; all water red; OB = the OSM course boundary, roads inside it are cart paths, the driving range is OB; North Shore wind 2-10 mph; trees from 3DEP lidar, trees in fairways or in the way of a centre-line drive removed and listed. Theme myopia (new; the course chat's design).

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (1345 x 1571 m, way/29689937) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: about 223 m west/east, 110 m south/north (held to 1,792 m tall: the 3DEP DEM the workflow fetched is 2,100 m tall and s00 needs the world + 32 m)

water_note: The two ponds inside the boundary (w1074606906, the 9th's pond, and w1074606912) are OSM natural=water only: red penalty areas through red_water_osm (standing default). Four small streams near hole lines (w1074606908, -09, -11, -13) are 0.1-0.4 m deep in the DEM and show no open water on the photo: rough, not penalty areas (open item). The club's swimming pool is rough.
